newsitem.title: USA: ArQule, Genzyme in drug pact.
newsitem.headline: ArQule, Genzyme in drug pact.

text.p: ArQule Inc said Wednesday that it and Genzyme Corp-General Division have a partnership for the identification, optimization and development of novel drug candidates for the treatment of cancer, infectious diseases, and autoimmune/inflammatory diseases.
This collaboration will provide Genzyme with access to ArQule's Mapping Array program for the identification of new lead compounds against Genzyme's biological targets.
ArQule's Mapping Array program is comprised of libraries of novel, diverse, small organic, pure compounds used for screening against biological targets in new product discovery.
